subject: Re: Confirmation of geofencing, residency artifacts, and scheduled tenant purge
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@greenleaf.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: sec-ops@greenleaf.com
Date: 2026-11-08T15:12:00Z
Subject: Confirmation of data residency controls and purge schedule

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the earlier call. To close our internal audit we need a short written confirmation of the following for our Dedicated tenant (tenant-id: GL-7721):

1) Which physical region the active serving instances and primary snapshots are pinned to (region + cloud provider).
2) Whether any backups or snapshots are replicated outside that region and if so under what policy.
3) The standard timeline and steps you take to perform a tenant-scoped purge (from request to verified wipe).
4) Evidence artifacts you can produce (logs, snapshot manifests, signed attestation).

We'd like to schedule the actual purge for a test tenant the week of Nov 15; please confirm a 2-hour window for the operation and the type of evidence we should expect immediately after completion.

Appreciate a concise response we can attach to the audit.

Best,
Elena
Elena Morris
Sr. Information Security Manager
Greenleaf Bank
[Phone redacted]
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@greenleaf.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-09T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Confirmation of data residency controls and purge schedule

Elena — thanks for the clear list. Summary and next steps below (short answers for audit; details and artifacts attached).

1) Region pinning: active serving and primary snapshot storage for tenant GL-7721 are pinned to us-west-2 (AWS). We pin the tenant control plane metadata to us-west-2 and configure storage buckets/volumes in the same region.

2) Backups/replication: automatic cold snapshots are taken but are NOT configured for cross-region replication for Dedicated tenants unless explicitly requested in the contract. For GL-7721 there is no replication configured. Occasional diagnostic exports (encrypted) are produced on demand and require separate approval.

3) Purge timeline and steps (tenant-scoped):
- T0: Customer request via support or signed DocuSign initiation.
- T+0-2 hours: Scheduling window confirmed with ops and customer.
- T+2-6 hours: Lock tenant, flush KV caches, revoke active tokens.
- T+6-18 hours: Execute secure wipe of attached volumes, delete snapshots, and remove metadata entries.
- T+18-24 hours: Run verification job (file handles, remaining object manifests) and generate manifest.
- T+24-48 hours: External witness (if requested) and final attestation signed by Redwood Security. Typical full completion to attestation: 24–48 hours.

4) Evidence artifacts we provide:
- wipe_manifest_<date>.csv (object ids removed, bucket paths)
- snapshot_map.csv (pre-wipe snapshot listing)
- operator_runbook_log.txt (ops steps and timestamps)
- signed attestation PDF (DocuSign)

Attachments in this message: [Attachment: erase_protocol_v1.pdf (PDF, 120KB)] and [Attachment: geolock_snapshot_map.csv (CSV, 6KB)]. I also added a Drive folder link for audit artifacts.

Scheduling: We can reserve a 2-hour window on Nov 16 14:00–16:00 UTC for a test purge. Please confirm whether you want Redwood or a Greenleaf witness to join and whether you require a livestream of the ops window.

Neha will own the purge runbook; Aditya will coordinate the attestation paperwork.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Security
Redwood Inference
[laura@redwood.ai]

From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@greenleaf.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: sec-ops@greenleaf.com
Date: 2026-11-10T11:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Confirmation of data residency controls and purge schedule

Laura — this is great, thank you. A few quick clarifications before we confirm the window:

- For the verification job, can you confirm whether the manifest includes checksums or only object ids/paths? We need checksums for our integrity proof.
- Will the signed attestation include the exact timestamps for each critical step (lock, wipe start, wipe complete, verification complete)?
- We would like a Red/Green witness on the call and a short (10–15 minute) post-op runbook review. Can Neha join as the ops lead?

If those are fine we'll confirm Nov 16 14:00–16:00 UTC and prepare an internal Greenleaf witness (SecOps + Legal).

Thanks,
Elena
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@greenleaf.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-12T18:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Confirmation of data residency controls and purge schedule

Elena — yes to all. Quick confirmations: 

- The verification manifest includes object ids, bucket paths, and SHA256 checksums for each object removed; filename: wipe_manifest_20261116.csv.
- The attestation PDF will include operator timestamps for key events (lock start, wipe start, wipe complete, verification start, verification complete) and will be signed via DocuSign.
- Neha will be the ops lead and will join the window; she will run the live verification and keep the runbook log.

We have Nov 16 14:00–16:00 UTC reserved and we'll share the DocuSign attestation link after completion. I'll upload preliminary artifacts to the Drive folder linked below so your legal team can pre-check the format.

Drive folder: https://drive.redwood/reports/greenleaf/geohome-evidence-2026Q4
DocuSign (post-op): https://app.docusign.com/greenleaf/geolock-attestation

If anything changes I'll update this thread.

Thanks — Laura
